tooltips.hideHUDTip: Hide the recording bar. Show it again from the tray icon.
tooltips.restartRecording: Delete this recording and start a new one
tooltips.systemAudio: System audio: records the sound your computer plays
tooltips.camera: Camera: records you as a separate layer you can move in the editor
tooltips.openStudio: Open Studio: the editor for your recordings
tooltips.openNotes: Open Notes: text to read while you record

notesToolbar.mirrorTip: Flip the text left to right, to read it in a mirror

cursor.name: Editable cursor
cursor.editableTip: Editable cursor: recorded separately, so you can restyle it and auto-zoom in the editor
cursor.systemTip: System cursor: your real cursor, recorded in the video. No restyling, no auto-zoom.

sourceSelector.emptyDescription: If you just granted screen recording permission, reload this picker. On macOS you may need to reopen Reaction Station.
sourceSelector.loadFailedDescription: Reaction Station couldn't load your screens and windows. Reload this picker and try again.

recording.selectSource: Choose a screen or window to record
recording.systemPicker: Your system will ask what to share

systemLanguagePrompt.title: Use your system language?
systemLanguagePrompt.description: We detected {{language}} as your system language. Do you want to switch Reaction Station to {{language}}?

softwareEncoderFallback.title: Switched to a backup encoder
softwareEncoderFallback.description: Your graphics card's encoder didn't start, so Reaction Station switched to a backup. Your recording is fine, though your computer may work a little harder.

permissions.title: Reaction Station needs a few permissions
permissions.subtitle: macOS asks you to grant each one once. You can change them at any time in System Settings.

screen.name: Screen & system audio
screen.description: To record your screen and the sound your Mac plays.

systemAudio.name: System audio
systemAudio.description: To record the sound your Mac plays. Choosing a screen or window needs no permission.

accessibility.name: Accessibility
accessibility.description: To show the right cursor (pointer, text) in your recordings.

camera.name: Camera
camera.description: To add your webcam to your recordings.

help.screenPrompt: macOS will then ask you to turn on Reaction Station in System Settings.
help.screenSettings: In System Settings, turn on Reaction Station. If macOS offers to quit and reopen it, accept: this window will come back.
help.screenNotListed: Reaction Station isn't in the list? Click +, then choose Reaction Station in Applications.
help.screenRestart: Allowed. Reaction Station needs to restart before it can use it.
help.screenRecurring: On your first recording, macOS will ask whether Reaction Station may access your screen directly, without the system picker. Click Allow. macOS asks again from time to time; that's expected.
help.systemAudioPrompt: macOS will ask you to allow Reaction Station to record the sound your Mac plays.
help.systemAudioRequested: If you said no, turn on Reaction Station under “System Audio Recording Only” in System Settings.

footer.screenRequired: Screen recording is needed to record.

reaction.enableBefore: Enable this source before starting your take.
reaction.mixHint: Balance your voice and the video before recording.
reaction.liveMixHint: Adjust the recorded sound without interrupting your take.
reaction.unsupported: Live mixing is currently available on Windows and browser capture.
reaction.hotkeyHint: These shortcuts work outside the app while the recorder is open. Change them between takes.
reaction.shortcutsFailed: Could not save shortcuts. Check for conflicting combinations.
